priority.override_reason: Exact queue ranks 1 through 13 are closed by the current documented scheduler, direct-leaf, typed-loop, RegExp, string, object/property, constructor, recursive-call, and allocation evidence. The fresh rank-14 profile exposes a different shared-cell cost: Op::NewFunction repeatedly overlays the same live local Upvalue identities into one shared dynamic-binding map. This unit removes only identity-equal replacement work and leaves every absent or changed cell on the existing insertion path. Selection depends on binding identity alone and has no workload, source-path, name, checksum, iteration-count, or expected-result condition.

mechanism.summary: Make the shared dynamic-cell overlay idempotent: before frame_deopt_bindings clones an owned name and replaces a map entry, compare the existing same-name Upvalue by cell identity and skip the replacement when it already names the exact live cell.
mechanism.generality: Every function, class, private element, or dynamic compatibility path that already asks frame_deopt_bindings to expose live slot cells uses the same identity-preserving operation. An absent name or a different cell still clones the name and performs the current map replacement, so first capture, block shadow changes, parameter cells, eval-introduced bindings, and later closure creation retain the established shared DynamicBindings behavior. An identical cell is already the required binding, making a second replacement observably redundant. Ordinary frames without deopt bindings retain the unchanged None path.
semantic_risks: the equality check must use Upvalue pointer identity rather than JavaScript value equality, because two shadowing bindings can currently contain equal values while requiring distinct cells
an absent entry or a same-name entry backed by a different cell must still replace the map entry so lexical shadow changes and newly captured locals remain visible to later direct eval and closures
the check and conditional replacement must occur under one short mutable DynamicBindings borrow without holding that borrow across JavaScript execution
the optimization must not fork, snapshot, filter, or otherwise change the shared dynamic map, its lookup order, or the existing first-insertion and write-through semantics

Inside that opcode, HashMap insertion has 125 exclusive samples, String cloning 42, and allocator/free leaves 512; the formatter constructs 28 nested local functions per invocation while the frame's DynamicBindings map and live Upvalue identities are shared. The repeated identity-equal overlays are distinct from the retained selected direct-eval call environment, rejected sparse eval frame, and rejected capture-repair scan: this mechanism changes neither eval export cardinality nor writeback and removes only redundant shared-map replacement.
